title: My Services
subtitle: What I Offer
description: I provide comprehensive web solutions tailored to your business needs. From building stunning WordPress websites to managing complex server infrastructures.

services.title: WordPress Development
services.description: Custom WordPress websites built from scratch or using premium themes. I create fully responsive, SEO-optimized websites that drive results.

services.title: VPS Server Setup & Management
services.description: Complete VPS configuration from scratch. I set up secure, high-performance Linux servers optimized for WordPress and web applications.

services.title: Domain & DNS Management
services.description: Expert domain management including DNS configuration, email setup, CDN integration, and SSL certificate management.

services.title: WordPress Speed Optimization
services.description: Make your WordPress site lightning fast. I optimize your site for Core Web Vitals, reducing load times and improving user experience.

services.title: Website Migration
services.description: Seamless migration of your WordPress site from any hosting to a new server or hosting provider with zero downtime.

services.title: WordPress Security & Maintenance
services.description: Protect your WordPress site from hackers and malware. Regular maintenance, updates, backups, and security monitoring.

process.title: Discovery
process.description: We discuss your project requirements, goals, and timeline to understand exactly what you need.

process.title: Planning
process.description: I create a detailed project plan with milestones, deliverables, and technical specifications.

process.title: Development
process.description: I build your solution with clean code, best practices, and regular progress updates.

process.title: Delivery
process.description: Final testing, deployment, and handover with full documentation and support.
